The project rule this serves: a handover ticket must CONTAIN the JS/CSS the developer pastes
into ODC — not just point at a repo path. A dev working inside ODC Studio cannot follow a link
into a repo they don't have open.
Entry shape — either a plain file list:
…or an object that also pins a fully-filled Mentor Studio prompt:
`mentor.kind` is one of: web-component | block | restyle. When `mentor` is omitted the prompt
is derived from the artifact kind automatically.
A handover with no code to embed (a screen walkthrough, say) still gets an entry: `"screen.md": []`.
Tokens are NOT listed here — they travel once via dist/theme.css, which is its own paste.
Add an entry for every new handover. A handover with no entry gets no embedded code, and the
embed silently goes stale when its source changes — so keep this in sync (check:state warns).

prompts.title: Prompt A — the TokenReference Block (<<LSG_MODULE>>)
prompts.text:
Goal: In ODC Studio, create the Live Style Guide Block TokenReference for the <<DESIGN_SYSTEM_NAME>> design system. It renders every design token of one kind, read live from the theme, through a provided script.
Module: <<LSG_MODULE>>.

Context (already done manually — do NOT re-create or edit these):
- dist/theme.css is pasted into the theme of <<THEME_MODULE>>, which this module uses.
- lsg-token-reference.js is imported in this module as a Script named "LsgTokenReference". It defines window.LsgTokenReference with init, update and destroy.
- Do NOT author or modify JavaScript beyond the three one-line calls below, and do NOT edit the Theme.

Task — create these elements, referencing each by the exact name given:

1. A Static Entity "TokenKind" with a single Text attribute "Value" set as the record Identifier (delete the default Id, Label, Order and Is_Active attributes), and these records:
     Color = "color", FontSize = "font-size", FontWeight = "font-weight", Space = "space",
     Radius = "radius", BorderSize = "border-size", Shadow = "shadow"
2. A Block "TokenReference", in a UI Flow named "StyleGuideReferences", with:
   - input parameters: Kind (TokenKind Identifier, mandatory), Heading (Text), Filter (Text), Exclude (Text);
   - one Placeholder named "Intro";
   - Required Scripts: the one Script "LsgTokenReference". Do not load it any other way.
3. The Block's widget tree, exactly:
     Container "Root", Style Classes "lsg-token-ref"
       If Heading <> "": an HTML Element with Tag "h2", Style Classes "lsg-token-ref__heading", containing an Expression = Heading
       Container, Style Classes "lsg-token-ref__intro", containing the Placeholder "Intro"
       Container "Body", empty — the script renders into it at runtime
4. Three Block event handlers, each a Client Action with one "Run JavaScript" node. Give each node a Text input WidgetId = Body.Id; OnReady and OnParametersChanged also take Kind, Filter and Exclude as inputs. Paste exactly:
     OnReady:             LsgTokenReference.init($parameters.WidgetId, { kind: $parameters.Kind, filter: $parameters.Filter, exclude: $parameters.Exclude });
     OnParametersChanged: LsgTokenReference.update($parameters.WidgetId, { kind: $parameters.Kind, filter: $parameters.Filter, exclude: $parameters.Exclude });
     OnDestroy:           LsgTokenReference.destroy($parameters.WidgetId);
5. Paste the provided lsg-token-reference.css into the Block's Style Sheet, unchanged.

OutSystems UI rules to follow: never edit the OutSystems UI module; never paste HTML into an Expression or an HTML Element; store nothing on $public.

After generating, list every element you created by name, and flag anything you could not finish.
Start with steps 1 and 2 and show them to me before building the widget tree.

prompts.title: Prompt B — the Styles screens (<<LSG_MODULE>>)
prompts.text:
Goal: In ODC Studio, put the TokenReference Block on the Styles screens of the Live Style Guide for the <<DESIGN_SYSTEM_NAME>> design system.
Module: <<LSG_MODULE>>.

Context: the Block TokenReference and the Static Entity TokenKind already exist in this module (previous prompt). Do NOT edit them, and do NOT write CSS or JavaScript.

Task:
1. On each Styles screen, inside the layout's MainContent placeholder, place TokenReference with:
     Colors        Kind = Entities.TokenKind.Color
     Typography    Kind = Entities.TokenKind.FontSize, then a second instance with Kind = Entities.TokenKind.FontWeight and Heading = "Font weights"
     Spacing       Kind = Entities.TokenKind.Space
     Border radius Kind = Entities.TokenKind.Radius
     Border size   Kind = Entities.TokenKind.BorderSize
     Shadow        Kind = Entities.TokenKind.Shadow
   If a screen does not exist yet, create it in the same flow as the other Styles screens, on the module's default layout, and add it to the menu the same way the existing Styles screens are.
2. Move each screen's intro text (and on Colors, the brand narrative) into the Block's Intro placeholder. Remove any hand-built swatch, scale or table the Block now renders.

After generating, list each screen, the Block instance(s) on it with their Kind, and every widget you removed.
